title.en: Jewish symbols in Roman gold glass
title.zh: 罗马金箔玻璃上的犹太象征

alt.en: Two broken greenish glass pieces carry gold outlines of a central cabinet, branching lamps and curved lettering around the rim.
alt.zh: 两块破碎的淡绿色玻璃上，金色线条勾出中央柜体、分枝灯架及沿边缘环绕的文字。

caption.en: Bowl fragments with menorah, shofar and Torah ark, Roman, 300–350 CE. Glass and gold leaf; The Metropolitan Museum of Art, 18.145.1a, b.
caption.zh: 带烛台、羊角号及经柜的碗残片，罗马，公元300至350年。玻璃与金箔；大都会艺术博物馆，18.145.1a, b。

interpretation.en: The museum identifies a Torah ark and Jewish ritual implements picked out in gold leaf. This Roman vessel preserves a different kind of community evidence from the Dura-Europos buildings discussed below.
interpretation.zh: 馆方识别出以金箔描出的经柜与犹太仪式器物。这件罗马器皿与下文杜拉欧罗普斯建筑，保存了不同形式的社群证据。

note.en: The exact item page labels the image Public Domain; the official API confirms isPublicDomain=true.
note.zh: 单件页面将图像标为公共领域，官方API确认isPublicDomain=true。

transformation.en: Official derivative saved unchanged, including surviving edges and marks.
transformation.zh: 原样保存官方衍生图，保留存世边缘及痕迹。

alt.en: An aged title page names A Vindication of the Rights of Woman and Mary Wollstonecraft above a London imprint and the date 1792.
alt.zh: 泛黄扉页列出《女权辩护》与玛丽·沃斯通克拉夫特姓名，下方为伦敦出版信息及1792年。

caption.en: Mary Wollstonecraft, A Vindication of the Rights of Woman, London: J. Johnson, 1792; title page. Princeton University Library, Sid Lapidus Collection.
caption.zh: 玛丽·沃斯通克拉夫特《女权辩护》，伦敦：J.约翰逊，1792年；扉页。普林斯顿大学图书馆，西德·拉皮杜斯收藏。

interpretation.en: The printed title places women’s rights beside political and moral questions. The visible author, publisher and date anchor the argument in a specific publication rather than a later portrait.
interpretation.zh: 印刷书名将女性权利与政治、道德问题并置。可见的作者、出版者与日期把论述定位于一部具体刊本，而非后世肖像。

items.creator: Mary Wollstonecraft; printed for J. Johnson
items.credit: Princeton University Library, The Sid Lapidus ’59 Collection on Liberty and the American Revolution, EX Lapidus 3.34

note.en: The exact item and full manifest state No Known Copyright. The catalogue dates this edition to 1792 and its author to 1759–1797; Princeton Library claims no copyright in its digital reproductions.
note.zh: 单件记录与完整清单标示无已知版权。目录将此版定为1792年、作者生卒定为1759至1797年；普林斯顿图书馆不对其数字复制品主张版权。

transformation.en: Official derivative saved unchanged, including surviving edges and marks.
transformation.zh: 原样保存官方衍生图，保留存世边缘及痕迹。
